services.desc: At our location or yours we provide a catered event with beach and water games for all. Tug of War, Bean Bag Toss, Volleyball, or just sit back and catch the rays. No party too big or too small! While enjoying a beautiful Beach Party we can cater your event with our local on sight staff from RUMBA ISLAND CUISINE, COWFISH, AND SCOTTOS ITALIAN PORK STORE. East End Jet Ski 91 Foster Ave. Hampton Bays NY 11946 @ the foot of the Ponquogue

blurb: Tired of being a spectator? Discover the most exciting sport ever to hit the water. For over 40 Years East End Jet Ski has been your source for fun in the sun. Our qualified professionals are always on premises and offer a full class of instruction and fit you into a life jacket.
